insert into spas_score_detail( paper_id, question_id, student_id, batch_id, score, full_score, rate, score_source, create_time ) values ( #{paperId}, #{questionId}, #{studentId}, #{batchId}, #{score}, #{fullScore}, #{rate}, coalesce(#{scoreSource}, '2'), now() ) on conflict (paper_id, question_id, student_id) do update set prev_batch_id = spas_score_detail.batch_id, prev_score = spas_score_detail.score, prev_full_score = spas_score_detail.full_score, prev_rate = spas_score_detail.rate, batch_id = excluded.batch_id, score = excluded.score, full_score = excluded.full_score, rate = excluded.rate, score_source = excluded.score_source, update_time = now() where spas_score_detail.batch_id is distinct from excluded.batch_id or spas_score_detail.score is distinct from excluded.score or spas_score_detail.full_score is distinct from excluded.full_score or spas_score_detail.rate is distinct from excluded.rate or spas_score_detail.score_source is distinct from excluded.score_source
